lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno's head went floating high,
Up in the clouds, up in the sky!
Kiki called, come back down here,
Your head's not really up there, dear!
[chorus]
Head in the clouds, head in the clouds,
Dreaming away, lost in the crowds!
Head in the clouds, head in the clouds,
Drifting off with fluffy clouds!
[verse]
It means you're dreaming all the day,
Your mind is floating far away,
Not listening to what you're taught,
Come back down and share your thought!
[chorus]
Head in the clouds, head in the clouds,
Dreaming away, lost in the crowds!
Head in the clouds, head in the clouds,
Come back down and laugh out loud!
[outro]
So when you're dreaming, drifting proud,
Don't keep your head up in the cloud!
